h1: Groups of four M15 in each CLOSE-date ordinal sequence; publish only count=4 and last-first=45min; discard incomplete/gapped blocks without repacking. Recursive indicators cross dates and years.
indicators: adjust=False EWM: EMA75 min75, slope5, Wilder ATR14 min14, ADX14 min14; H1 ATR/rolling20 ATR mean>1 and ADX>20; LONG H1 Close>EMA and slope>0, SHORT reverse; M15 Donchian20 strictly prior candles, strict Close breakout
trailing: Immediate after each survived post-entry completed candle; favorable accumulated extreme minus side*3.5*current ATR; tighten only; effective next observed candle; no +1R delay
event_order: Resolve pending using only adjacency and Open; check old Stop (adverse Open fill, else intrabar touch at Stop); survived candle trail; evaluate completed Close signal; one position per symbol; same-Close reentry allowed after exit
signal_close: IDEALIZED_SIGNAL_CLOSE; enter at completed signal Close; never stop-test or trail on signal extremes
next_open: CAUSAL_NEXT_OPEN; immediately adjacent next M15 Open timestamp=signal Close; absent adjacency cancel; initial Stop live on execution candle
exit_timestamp: Frozen historical EXIT candle CLOSE timestamp, including Open-gap exits. Metrics sort exit_time/instrument/trade_id; years/months by that timestamp
costs: GROSS_ONLY; user prohibits FINAM cost modelling
selection: Fixed user choice, no parameter search; retrospective replication, no new OOS or LIVE claim
repeats: First full independent run and two fresh full deterministic reruns; every generated CSV/JSON/gzip/report byte compared
independence: New dataframe primary and separately written stdlib streaming verifier; no frozen executable imports; one author, no external human audit
stop: One Draft PR; no merge, auto-merge or LIVE
